A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Before you
spread your wings.

How does camera control work?

Flap Fit uses your front camera to estimate body landmarks and translate your movement into bird movement. Set your phone on a stable surface and follow the in-game calibration. Good lighting and a clear view of your movement help tracking.

Does Flap Fit verify exercise form?

No. Camera tracking controls the game; it does not verify correct exercise form. Progress uses tracked active gameplay time, not medically or competitively verified exercise time. No calorie-burn or health-outcome guarantee is made.

Is camera video uploaded?

The current app processes camera video live on your device and does not record, save, or upload it. Tracking software is downloaded from third-party services. Online scores and challenges use separate game data. Read the privacy overview for details.

What do I need to play?

A phone with a front camera, enough room for your selected exercise, and a stable place for your phone. Pull-ups require a suitable bar; weighted exercises require suitable weights. Online features and initial tracking downloads need a connection.

Where can I download Flap Fit?

Flap Fit is currently in development. Store availability and a release date have not been announced here. Confirmed download links will be added when they are available.
